$comment: The single source of truth for the Hatsi360 image library. Consumed by scripts/build_image_library.py (which produces the optimised derivatives and the licence manifest) and by src/lib/images/registry.ts (which resolves an image for a route, a commodity slug or a market id). Every entry names a source original held in assets/image-sources/ and states the licence, the subject and the alternative text.
